summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated infrastructure for data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale — they matter when you're building or customizing your own models, managing many experiments, or need governance and reproducible pipelines. If you only consume a pre-trained model via an API (e.g., OpenAI or a managed foundation-model endpoint), you typically don't need a full platform; these tools become essential once you train/fine-tune models, serve them in production, or require MLOps rigor across teams. The landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), followed by Databricks and specialized AutoML/MLOps players.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hours, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fee. Separate charges for training jobs, notebooks, and inference endpoints.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building, training, and deploying custom models end-to-end at scale

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training node-hours, prediction node-hours, and AutoML usage; generative models priced per token/character.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a highly automated, state-of-the-art managed pipeline with strong AutoML and Gemini/foundation-model access

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by underlying Azure compute, storage, and managed endpoints; no separate platform fee.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and Azure OpenAI integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing in DBUs (Databricks Units) layered on top of underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload type.
platforms.best_for: Unified data engineering plus collaborative data science and LLM development across clouds

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/license (custom quote), typically annual contracts based on usage and seats.
platforms.best_for: Business and analytics teams wanting automated model building with strong governance and low code

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; team/enterprise subscription priced per seat and usage; self-hosted enterprise options.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and LLM observability

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core is free; Driverless AI and enterprise GenAI products are commercial subscriptions (custom quote).
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting flexible open-source AutoML plus enterprise GenAI across deployment environments

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; pay only for active execution, free credits for new users.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, Python-native GPU infrastructure for fine-tuning and scalable inference

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription and usage-based Inference Endpoints/compute; enterprise plans per seat.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformer and foundation models with easy fine-tuning and hosting

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
capabilities: foundation model access (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by tokens (on-demand) or provisioned throughput; fine-tuning and storage billed separately.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting managed access and customization of multiple foundation models within AWS
